title: Custom eggless baby shower and gender reveal cakes for Tallawong and Riverstone
summary:
A gender reveal cake needs to work before anyone knows what's inside — including whether every guest can eat it.

Every cake we make for Tallawong and Riverstone families is 100% eggless. Not the filling, not the sponge, not the buttercream. That covers a Jain grandmother, a vegetarian aunt, and the cousin with an egg allergy, without anyone asking first.

Baby shower and gender reveal designs are fully custom. Pink or blue filling, any theme, photo references welcome. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Riverstone Shopping Centre, free parking, open from 6am weekdays. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
